title: What cost 100 in 2010 costs THIS much in Turkey today
description: Same shopping, three countries: Switzerland, the USA and Turkey. What does 100 in 2010 cost now in your country? Real World Bank data.
source: World Bank, consumer price index (2010 = 100, latest 2024), data.worldbank.org

segments.text: This cost one hundred in 2010. Guess the price now in Switzerland.
One hundred six. Almost nothing changed.
Same shopping in America. One hundred in 2010.
Now one forty-four. Up forty-four percent.
Now Turkey. Also one hundred in 2010.
One thousand three hundred twenty-three. Thirteen times more.
What does it cost in your country? Follow for more.
